question: Which certifications do entry-level IT support jobs mention?
sources:
[1] IT Support Specialist at Creative Financial Staffing (CFS) (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-06)

Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certifications, Cisco Certifications, etc.Experience working for a Managed Services Provider (MSP)Experience with any of the following: ConnectWise, IT Glue, SolarWinds, WatchGuard, Ruckus, Veeam, Cisco Networking Products, Extreme Network Products, Ubiquiti, VMWare, Dell, Axix, 3OX and Adobe.Experience with LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, Routers, Switches, Firewalls, Access Points, VPN, Citrix, VoIP, etc.

[2] Desktop Support Analyst at Social Capital Resources (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-11)
Education and Certifications
Associate’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (preferred but not required).Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, or similar certifications are a plus.
Additional Information
This is a full-time position based at our primary bank location but will require support of our 2 local branches. The Desktop Support Analyst will be part of a collaborative team dedicated to providing exceptional IT services to our users.
We look forward to hearing from you!

[3] Technical Support Representative at TEKsystems (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-19)
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field preferred. NOT A MUST HAVE
Proven experience in a technical support or customer service role. Strong understanding of computer hardware, software, and networking concepts. Proficiency in troubleshooting technical issues and providing solutions. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment. Customer-focused with a passion for delivering exceptional service. Experience using CRM systems or helpdesk software is a plus. Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP) are desirable.
Experience Level
Intermediate Level

[4] IT Systems Administrator at Hendrickson (entry, kaggle_linkedin, 2024-04-18)
Minimum Qualifications
Experience: At least three years of experience in desktop support or system administration, with a proven track record of resolving complex technical issues. Technical Skills: Proficient with the latest versions of Microsoft Windows Workstation, Server Operating Systems, Active Directory, and familiarity with various Microsoft tools and applications. Knowledge of backup methodologies, such as CommVault or equivalent, is highly desirable. Interpersonal Skills: Strong ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users, offering both group and individual support and training. Legal Knowledge: Awareness of federal copyright and privacy laws related to computer software use. Flexibility: Willingness to work evenings and weekends as needed to support critical system requirements. Certifications: Current certifications in Cisco (such as CCNA) and Microsoft technologies (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Fundamentals) are preferred but not mandatory.
Physical Demands
